errors.text_span: с равномерно разпределени етикети през една година
errors.evidence: The phrase "през една година" in Bulgarian typically means "every other year". The x-axis has labels for every single year from 2012 to 2019, not every other year.

errors.text_span: През 2018 година стойността е около 21 000 EUR
errors.evidence: The value for 2018 on the chart is visibly below the 21,000 mark, closer to 20,800. Stating it is "around 21,000" is an overestimation.
